explication: Hermes Agent is a self-improving, multi-surface AI agent. A user submits a turn through the CLI/TUI, desktop, or messaging gateway; the runtime manages context, selects a model, executes tools, persists the session, and returns a streamed response. The same runtime also supports memory and skill learning, scheduled jobs, subagents, voice input, research trajectories, and optional meeting-summary integrations. The tree and excerpts establish these subsystems, but several cross-module implementations were not sampled, so uncertain internal links are omitted.
